hull.prompt: Top-down orthographic photograph of a real spacecraft exterior hull surface, flat and evenly lit, seamless tileable texture. Matte off-white thermal-control paint with a chalky, diffuse, non-glossy finish over composite structural panels. Rectangular panels of varied sizes, each roughly one to two metres across, separated by thin recessed seams; rows of small flush countersunk fasteners along the panel edges; a few small flush access hatches with rounded corners. Realistic weathering: faint scuffs, light grime settled in the seams, slight panel-to-panel colour variation from warm white to pale grey. The panel grid continues evenly across every edge. No text or markings.
